title: Historic District Violation
description: Use this service request to report structures that do not comply with the historic district preservation criteria. Historic districts are a type of zoning district designation that helps to preserve and protect the character of Dallas architecturally unique neighborhoods. If this is a substandard structure in a Historical or Conservation District please use report it to Code Compliance. The estimated response time for a request of this nature is 2 business days

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request to report a structure that violates historic-district preservation criteria.
actions.why: To report a structure that does not comply with preservation criteria in a Dallas Historic District and affects the character of an architecturally unique neighborhood. The 311 request form asks which Historic District, whether the building is under construction now and, if Yes, whether it is new construction, an addition, or remodeling, whether a Certificate of Appropriateness is posted, and which issue applies, such as windows or doors, fencing or landscaping, siding, paint, roofing, signs, exterior alterations, or another violation.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Historic District Violation" requests does not apply to a substandard structure in a Historic or Conservation District. If the structure is substandard, then submit a "Code Concerns" 311 request instead.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Other Requests" > Choose "Historic District Violation"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Other Requests" > Choose "Historic District Violation"

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about a substandard structure in a Historic or Conservation District.
actions.why: For a substandard structure in a Historic or Conservation District. The description for "Historic District Violation" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs these concerns to Code Compliance, and the saved "Code Concerns" record accepts reports of substandard conditions.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "City Code Violations" > Choose "Code Concerns"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "City Code Violations" > Choose "Code Concerns"
